说明: 本文件在机载开机自动启动或操作员主动启动时读取。{uav_id} 自动替换为所选无人机编号，{model} 替换为 p600 或 su17。指令在机载 ~/competition_development 中由 Bash 执行。修改后在对应程序打印窗口先停止程序，再点击启动程序；只启动该程序，不会自动重启已有程序。

commands.detection:
source ~/SpireCV_bj/src/spirecv-ros/devel/setup.bash
roslaunch spirecv_ros uav_yolo26_botsort_geolocation.launch uav_id:={uav_id} runtime_mode:=debug debug_save_dir:=/tmp/yolo_debug debug_save_dir_all:=/tmp/yolo_debug_all camera_params:=/home/amov/SpireCV_bj/src/spirecv-ros/sv-rosapp/camera_params/calib_gx40_720.yaml
commands.flight: source ~/recon_ws/devel/setup.bash && exec roslaunch px4_north_camera p600_gx40_position_pid_reconnaissance.launch uav_id:={uav_id} flight_mode:=outdoor reconnaissance_mode:=2
